propositions: fsck.py exceeds the 800 LOC soft cap at 855 lines and needs to be split into smaller, maintainable modules.
The repair cluster (A3-remediation functions and their support helpers) is cohesive and can be extracted into a separate sibling module fsck_repair.py.
The read-only diagnostic scan functions must remain in fsck.py with selective re-imports of shared helpers to maintain unidirectional imports.

Back-compatibility must be preserved via re-exports so existing code importing from fsck.py continues to resolve (five key names: _resolve_tracker_git_dir, _repair_plan, _repair_ticket, _AUTO_RECOVER_ORPHAN_TYPES, _HUMAN_TRIAGE_ORPHAN_TYPES).
Module size allowlists, ceilings configuration, and architecture documentation must be updated to remove the grandfathered exception once the split is complete.
